title: EditAction
description: The only way a program changes after it is first written. Bounded and typed: no action can replace the program, and none carries code. Every action records what it touched and what it cost, and is appended to meta.provenance.

targets.description: Source node ids the action addresses. Written by the caller; applyEdit checks it.

decisionRefs.description: Inert: which stated decisions this action is meant to serve.

parent.description: add_node, reparent_node: id of the receiving group.

index.description: Paint-order position among the parent's children.

node.description: add_node: the subtree to insert. Validated as a program node.

path.description: set_arg: dotted path inside the node's args, e.g. "region.x" or "points.2.0".

value.description: set_arg: the replacement value. Must be the same shape as what it replaces.

groupId.description: wrap_group: id for the new group.

rngKey.description: duplicate_as_repeat: rngKey for the new repeat node.

before.description: Recorded by applyEdit: the value as it was.

after.description: Recorded by applyEdit: the value as it now is.

estimatedCost.description: Recorded by applyEdit: change in estimated render cost.
